verses.1: And man knew the beauty of his wife. She became pregnant and said, “I have given birth to a son. I have married a man for Jehovah.”
verses.2: And she became the mother of her brothers, Habel. Habel was a good shepherd, and he worked hard on tending the sheep.
verses.3: And after some time passed, a gift from the produce of the earth was brought as an offering to Jehovah.
verses.4: And the vulture also brought from his prey the meat and the blood. Then Jehovah saved the vulture and its food.
verses.5: And to Kain and to his offering, there was no time. He attacked Kain very fiercely, and his face fell.
verses.6: And the LORD said to Cain, “Why have you sinned? Why have your faces turned pale?”
verses.7: Perhaps it won’t be good to do so. And if it doesn’t work, then you’ll be unable to prevent the sin from spreading. Then you’ll be in trouble, and you’ll have to deal with its consequences.
verses.8: And Cain said to his brother Abel, “Let us go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain killed his brother Abel.
verses.9: And the LORD said to Cain, “Your brother Abel has died. Do you not remember that you were with him when he was alive?”
verses.10: And he said, “What have you done? Your brothers are crying out to me from the land.”
verses.11: And now, you have taken away from the land that you once possessed the life of your brother. You have taken his life from him right from your own hands.
verses.12: For if you work the land, it will not yield fruit for you. Its strength will be exhausted, and it will become worthless on this earth.
verses.13: And Cain said to the LORD, “Great is your kindness toward me!”
verses.14: Today, you have uprooted me from the surface of the earth. Ester stood between me and your face. I was lost in the wilderness, and anyone who came across me would kill me.
verses.15: And the LORD said to him, “For every one who kills a person, seven times he shall be punished. And the LORD will make sure that no one can harm him.”
verses.16: And Cain went away from the presence of Jehovah, and he settled in the land of Nod, before Eden.
verses.17: And Kain knew of his wife. He rushed to her and had a son. He built a city, and he named the city after his son, Hanok.
verses.18: And Hanoch had a son named Er, and Er had a son named Mahalalel. Mahalalel had a son named Methuselah, and Methuselah had a son named Lamech.
verses.19: And he took for his wife two women. The name of one of them was Adah, and the name of the other was Zilah.
verses.20: And Adah gave birth to Yaval. He was the father of those who dwelled in the tents and made goods.
verses.21: And the name of his brother was Yubal. He was the father of all those who were skilled in playing the harp and other musical instruments.
verses.22: And he also had a daughter named Tubal Cain. All the sons of Nebuchadnezzar were born from her. And Tubal Cain’s sister was Naama.
verses.23: And he said to Lemek’s women, “Hear my voice! My words are true. I have killed a man for my own wounds, and he will become a servant to me.”
verses.24: For twenty, it becomes one; and for seventy, it becomes seventy-five.
verses.25: And Adam knew his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. He named him Seth, because God said, “Let us make man in our image, after our likeness.” But he killed him immediately, for he was evil.
verses.26: And even he also became a son. He named him “Man”. Then he began to call him “YHWH”.
